title: hygiene(core,plugin-view,types): three leftovers from the objectui#7924 / #7928 retirements — the fold's `in` check walks the prototype chain, a dev-mode warning still teaches `options.KIND`, `NamedListView`'s docblock still names `listViews`
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #30 续 2, `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the objectui#7924 and objectui#7928 dev reports (5857154037, 5858080764), carried by the contract-review records 5860945101 (PR #10793) and 5860951313 (PR #10821), which asked for a carrier. Each item is measured by its dev and re-read by the seat; none has a public-door reproduction, so this is hygiene, not a defect card. Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` execution seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The three leftovers

1. **`packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts`, the density fold.** `normalizeListViewSchema` tests `legacyDensity in DENSITY_MODE_TO_ROW_HEIGHT`, and `in` walks the prototype chain: on the built package, `normalizeListViewSchema({ densityMode: 'toString' })` returns a `rowHeight` of `typeof function` and drops the key, while the control `'cozy'` stays unfolded. No producer writes such a value. `rowHeightToDensityMode` in the same file already guards the other direction with `hasOwnProperty`; the fold should use the same own-key test (or a `Map` / `Object.hasOwn`).
2. **`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, the dev-mode warning in `generateViewSchema`.** It still tells authors to "Move them under `options.KIND`". Since PR #10821 the named view is the protocol's strict record and `options` is refused by name; the warning now reads the host `views` entry only and teaches the retired nesting. Rewrite it to name the canonical top-level `KIND` block.
3. **`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, `NamedListView`'s own docblock.** It still says "Used in `ObjectViewSchema.listViews`". Since PR #10821 that member is `Record<string, z.input<typeof ObjectListViewSchema>>` and `NamedListView` types no channel; its retirement or narrowing follows objectui#7924's outcome. Until then the sentence should say what the type is for now (exported, unreferenced by the contract face).

## Fix

One small PR after PRs #10793 and #10821 land: an own-key test in the fold with a pin (`densityMode: 'toString'` stays unfolded, `'cozy'` control unchanged, `'compact'` still folds); the warning text; the docblock sentence. Changeset `patch` for `@object-ui/core` (a behaviour fix on an unreachable input) and `@object-ui/types` (a published docblock); `Clause-②: no`.

## Acceptance

- `normalizeListViewSchema({ densityMode: 'toString' })` folds nothing and keeps `rowHeight` undefined; the pin can fail.
- No dev-mode text in `plugin-view` names `options.KIND` as a place to write.
- `NamedListView`'s docblock names no channel it does not type.

Clause-②: no
